Nuckelavee

The nuckelavee is a horse-like demon from Orcadian folklore that combines equine and human elements. Its breath was thought to wilt crops and sicken livestock.

Description

Descriptions agree on a skinless body whose muscle and sinew are fully visible. The creature was said never to come ashore during rain.

  1. A rider fused to a horse body
  2. A single fiery eye
  3. Breath like venom

Reported sightings

YearLocationWitnesses
1834Kirkwall shore2
1893Stronsay1

Etymology

The name may derive from Orcadian knoggelvi, itself of uncertain origin. Compare the Shetland mukkelevi, a sea trow.
